mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(sales_orders.id) FROM sales_orders INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = sales_orders.customer_id INNER JOIN currency_centers ON currency_centers.id = sales_orders.currency_center_id

SELECT sales_orders.id AS id, sales_orders.order_date AS invoiceDate, sales_orders.so_code AS invoiceCode, COALESCE( (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(products.name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM products WHERE products.is_active = 1 AND products.id IN (SELECT product_id FROM sales_order_details WHERE sales_order_details.sales_order_id = sales_orders.id)), (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(services.name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM services WHERE services.is_active = 1 AND services.id IN (SELECT service_id FROM sales_order_services WHERE sales_order_services.sales_order_id = sales_orders.id)), (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(sales_order_miscs.description SEPARATOR ', ') FROM sales_order_miscs WHERE sales_order_miscs.sales_order_id = sales_orders.id), '' ) AS description, sales_orders.total_amount - IFNULL(sales_orders.discount, 0) AS subTotal, IFNULL(sales_orders.total_vat, 0) AS totalVat, sales_orders.total_amount - IFNULL(sales_orders.discount, 0) + IFNULL(sales_orders.total_vat, 0) AS totalAmount, sales_orders.balance AS balance, IF(balance > 0 AND DATEDIFF(now(), due_date) > 0, DATEDIFF(now(), due_date), '.') AS aging, sales_orders.status AS status FROM sales_orders INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = sales_orders.customer_id INNER JOIN currency_centers ON currency_centers.id = sales_orders.currency_center_id WHERE sales_orders.status != -1 AND sales_orders.is_pos = 0 AND sales_orders.company_id IN (SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AND sales_orders.location_group_id IN (SELECT location_group_id FROM user_location_groups WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AND sales_orders.customer_id = #{organizationId}
SELECT COUNT(customers.id) FROM sales_orders INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = sales_orders.customer_id INNER JOIN currency_centers ON currency_centers.id = sales_orders.currency_center_id
